## Ablation evidence, verbatim

Holding-question answered: **both ablations were run**, four runs in total — once each against the first draft, then re-run against the **final** assertions after the TEST_DEBT repair changed them (`?.slice().sort()` is not the expression the first run exercised, so the earlier red would not have covered the shipped code). Neither ablation was ever committed; both were applied to the working tree and reverted.

### 1. Window filter — `isGrantActive` + the `valid_from`/`valid_until` projection copied from `plugin-sharing/src/position-graph.ts` into `expandPositionUsers`

```
 ❯ src/approval-service.test.ts (288 tests | 1 failed) 248ms
     × position approver: an EXPIRED sys_user_position row STILL routes (ADR-0091 D2 is not applied here) 18ms

 FAIL  src/approval-service.test.ts > ApprovalService (node era) > position approver: an EXPIRED sys_user_position row STILL routes (ADR-0091 D2 is not applied here)
AssertionError: expected [ 'u6' ] to deeply equal [ 'u5', 'u6' ]

- Expected
+ Received

  [
-   "u5",
    "u6",
  ]

 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 287 passed (288)
```

Re-run at the final assertions: `× position approver: an EXPIRED sys_user_position row STILL routes …` / `AssertionError: expected [ 'u6' ] to deeply equal [ 'u5', 'u6' ]` / `Tests 1 failed | 287 passed (288)`.

### 2. Catalogue gate — a `sys_position` lookup returning `[]` on `active === false`

```
 ❯ src/approval-service.test.ts (288 tests | 1 failed) 203ms
     × position approver: the routing read never consults the sys_position catalogue 13ms

 FAIL  src/approval-service.test.ts > ApprovalService (node era) > position approver: the routing read never consults the sys_position catalogue
AssertionError: expected [ 'position:sales_manager' ] to deeply equal [ 'u5' ]

- Expected
+ Received

  [
-   "u5",
+   "position:sales_manager",
  ]

 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 287 passed (288)
```

Re-run at the final assertions: same case, same assertion, `Tests 1 failed | 287 passed (288)`.

On the specific worry that an absent-read assertion can pass for an unrelated reason: this run answers it. The *outcome* assertion fired first and it fired with the ruled regression stated literally — the slate collapsing to the `position:sales_manager` literal no user can act on (#3807 / #3424). The read did happen under ablation and the case caught it on both limbs.

### Each ablation reddens exactly ONE test

287 of 288 stay green in both runs. That is the card's premise measured rather than assumed: no other case in the suite covers this behaviour, which is precisely why "fixing" the unfiltered read would have gone unnoticed. It also rules out the fixtures being broken in some blunt way — the in-window control `u6` survives ablation 1, so the red is the window filter biting one row, not the seed failing.

### Restoration — byte identity, not eyeballing

```
git hash-object packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts   4f0a054ee2708ac86e5923063754adddd468a719
git rev-parse HEAD:packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts        4f0a054ee2708ac86e5923063754adddd468a719
git rev-parse origin/main:packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts 4f0a054ee2708ac86e5923063754adddd468a719
```

`git status --porcelain` empty, and `git diff --stat origin/main` is one file, `+91`, the test file only. Nothing outside `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/` was touched at any point.

### Reproducing it independently

Both ablations are three-line edits to `expandPositionUsers`, if you want the red without taking my word for it:

1. **Window** — projection to `fields: ['user_id', 'valid_from', 'valid_until']`, then `const nowMs = Date.now();` and `if (!isGrantActive(r, nowMs)) continue;` at the top of the row loop. (`isGrantActive` is already imported in the file — that is limb 1 of the doc block's point: the omission is per-read, not a missing dependency.)
2. **Catalogue** — before the `sys_user_position` read, `find('sys_position', { filter: { name: positionName, organization_id }, fields: ['active'], limit: 1 })` and `return []` when the row says `active === false`.

The structured report is on the card: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/8863#issuecomment-5306849240 — posted 09:56:19Z, before this probe arrived. Nothing else is outstanding.
